scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @gridiron/server & npm run dev -w @gridiron/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @gridiron/core && npm run test -w @gridiron/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/web --noEmit
scripts.test:pglite: npm run test -w @gridiron/core && TEST_DRIVER=pglite npm run test -w @gridiron/server
scripts.refresh:artifact: npm run refresh:data && npm run build:artifact
